why: Refuses the new puff at the cloud ceiling instead of recycling the oldest -- the obvious way to write the bound, and the way this was written until review. It drops smoke from the shot the player just fired and is watching, while a nearly-faded cloud from half a second ago keeps its slot. Only an assertion that identifies the NEWEST cloud can see it: nothing in that test calls `update`, so every cloud still sits at its birth opacity and a peak-opacity check would pass either way. The refusal's near-black tint against the shot's grey is what makes the newest identifiable.
killedBy: muzzle smoke (issue #536, parent #356) recycles the OLDEST cloud at budget, so the newest puff always survives
